owner_review_required: All 496 candidate entries; all question choices; all proposed mapping qualifications/corrections/removals.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Hypervisor patching, minimized virtual devices and restricted management reduce known guest-escape attack paths.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Hardening cannot prove the absence of unknown host or firmware vulnerabilities.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Protected integrity baselines can reveal altered boot or system components associated with a rootkit.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A compromised kernel can deceive in-guest tools; baseline and measurement trust must be independent where needed.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Verified boot-chain policy can reject unauthorized startup components and reduce some bootkit persistence.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Signed vulnerable components, compromised firmware and post-boot rootkits remain possible.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Process memory inspection can find injected or memory-resident code not represented by a malicious executable file.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Visibility and rapid execution limit coverage; fileless activity can still leave other artifacts.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Behavior analytics can identify suspicious use of interpreters and legitimate utilities in a fileless execution chain.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Legitimate automation can look unusual; alerts need context and response rather than automatic certainty.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Interpret source verification here as source-network IP anti-spoofing to reject forged reflection requests.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Checking an email sender does not stop reflection; victim-side filtering alone cannot control other originating networks.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Time-limited codes narrow the useful lifetime of captured authentication values when the verifier enforces appropriate checks.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Codes can be relayed or reused inside a window without single-use enforcement; they do not protect arbitrary messages.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Configuration and access audits can discover public permissions and verify their remediation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: An audit does not itself remove an exposed bucket policy and can miss changes between checks.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Encryption protects some storage or transport exposure under appropriate key and access arrangements.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not fix anonymous authorized reads when the service decrypts objects for public users; remove public permissions instead.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Use a cost-tuned salted password KDF to increase the work required per offline password guess.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A fast general-purpose hash, even a modern one, is not adequate password storage merely because it is called strong.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Anti-spyware detection and remediation can identify and remove supported surveillance software.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Novel or privileged surveillance may evade detection, and prior data theft cannot be undone by removal.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Restricting application permissions can reduce accessible sensors and personal data before a low-privilege spyware program collects them.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Privileged malware may bypass settings; permission review does not reliably remove an active infection.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Verified dedicated physical resources can reduce a co-tenant's access to the shared resource causing a leak.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Provider terminology differs; dedicated virtual placement may still share hardware, and same-host leakage can remain.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A controlled change process supports replacement of a cryptographically broken scheme after review and testing.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Change management is not chosen-plaintext security. The mapping needs explicit migration context rather than a prevention claim.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Compatible frequency-agile radios may tolerate some narrow-band interference by using other permitted channels.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Wideband or powerful jamming can affect all channels; this is not universal anti-jamming protection.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Backups may support recovery if a disruption coincides with data loss.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: They do not restore radio availability or counter interference; do not teach backups as a jamming defense.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Reduced Bluetooth discovery can lower casual exposure while approved connections remain necessary.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Known device addresses and exploitable services can remain reachable; patching or radio shutdown addresses different risks.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A trusted authenticated support channel can reduce exposure of sensitive information during verified assistance.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: An encrypted call can still be fraudulent; transport security alone does not defeat a convincing voice pretext.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: An approved challenge-response identity process can test a pretexting requester's claimed identity.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Public biographical questions are weak, and proof of identity does not authorize every requested disclosure.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Enforced handling procedures can define which information staff may disclose to a verified requester.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A privacy notice alone does not authenticate anyone or technically prevent pretexting.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Schema validation rejects malformed authentication messages before protocol processing.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Well-formed forged assertions remain possible without signature, issuer and freshness checks.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Monitoring domains, ads and abuse reports can discover impersonating content and support response.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Detection is not authentication of every message and does not automatically remove a fraudulent site.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Education helps users check trusted routes rather than trusting logos or familiar branding.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: People cannot reliably identify every impersonation; usable verification and technical controls remain necessary.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Locked collection containers reduce access before controlled removal and destruction.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: They leave the contents recoverable if the lock or collection chain is bypassed.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A screen privacy filter reduces off-axis observation of displayed information.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not stop a camera directly behind the user or observation of keyboard input.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A suitable biometric sign-in can reduce typing of reusable secrets that an observer could record.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not conceal an unlocked screen, prevent screen capture or solve every authentication-recovery path.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Independent power, cooling or service paths can preserve operation when an environmental component fails.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Shared failure domains and untested failover can defeat redundancy; backups and redundancy are different controls.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A verified clean image can remove accumulated unwanted software when rebuilding is appropriate.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Rebuilding is disruptive and may reinstall the same bundled programs if the image is not corrected.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Appropriate standardized post-quantum public-key mechanisms address identified quantum-vulnerable public-key operations.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Do not imply current quantum computers break every cipher, or that algorithm migration alone secures the whole protocol.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Browser ad-request filtering reduces unwanted advertisements and some malvertising exposure.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not uninstall all adware or establish that all permitted content is safe.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Verified distribution sources reduce deceptive or bundled software acquisition.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Legitimate publishers can distribute unwanted software or suffer compromise; reputation is not an integrity guarantee.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Correct context-specific escaping can reduce unsafe shell interpretation in constrained legacy paths.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Prefer avoiding a shell; quoting errors and argument injection can remain even when some metacharacters are escaped.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Explicit allowlists constrain permitted operations and inputs when combined with safe non-shell interfaces.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: An approved string can still be interpreted unsafely downstream; verify the complete command construction.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A WAF can block recognized SQL injection patterns while code remediation is arranged.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Bypasses and false positives remain; it is not a replacement for separating SQL instructions and data.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Non-executable data pages obstruct injection that depends on executing bytes in those pages.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Code reuse, executable mappings and other injection paths remain; DEP does not remove the vulnerability.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Independent source review can identify suspicious destructive triggers before acceptance.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Review may miss obfuscation, dependencies or code introduced after review in the build process.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Restricting changes to sensitive code and scheduled jobs reduces opportunities to plant destructive triggers.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: An already authorized maintainer may still abuse permitted access; access controls need separation of duties and oversight.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: User behavior analytics can flag unusual access or exports for investigation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Intent cannot be inferred reliably from anomaly alone; privacy and legitimate role changes require context.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Server-enforced idle and absolute lifetime limits reduce the usable window of a stolen session.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: An attacker can act before expiration or keep some sessions active; invalidation and reauthentication need additional design.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Authenticated encryption protects data across a path where an intermediary could observe or alter it.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Unauthenticated encryption does not establish peer identity, and compromised endpoints remain outside that guarantee.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Hardened resolvers with appropriate validation and controlled access reduce cache-poisoning exposure.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A resolver's reputation alone does not establish that every response is authenticated.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Managed fixed ARP bindings prevent unwanted dynamic replacement for selected stable peers.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Manual drift and compromised legitimate devices remain concerns; this does not scale automatically.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Relevant boundary rules can close exposed amplifiers or block identifiable abusive service traffic.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: The rule must be on an effective path; victim-side filtering cannot restore bandwidth already saturated upstream.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Validate function events and inputs before they influence resource selection or execution.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Valid input can still invoke an overprivileged function, and dependency flaws require additional controls.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A correctly configured modern Wi-Fi deployment removes weaknesses associated with obsolete protocol modes.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: WPA3 does not repair every access-point implementation flaw or make transition configurations uniformly safe.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: An assessed HSM can confine keys and sensitive operations within a hardened boundary.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Not every HSM or operation is free of side channels, and authorized misuse of the key can still occur.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Confirmed exposure reports can trigger credential invalidation and investigation before further stuffing attempts.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Breach intelligence is incomplete and delayed; observing exposure does not itself prevent a login.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Appropriate additional authentication factors reduce takeover with a guessed password alone.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Phishable factors, weak recovery and already stolen sessions can undermine protection; prefer phishing-resistant methods.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: HSTS reduces browser HTTP fallback for the protected origin after valid policy learning or appropriate preload.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not prevent every TLS protocol downgrade and does not authenticate an unrelated look-alike domain.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Wireless sensors and inventory comparison can find unapproved access points and support assessed response.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Detection can miss radios or misclassify legitimate equipment; automated disruption needs legal and operational review.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: MAC lists can assist limited local device administration.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Spoofable MAC addresses do not authenticate an access point or reliably prevent unauthorized AP deployment; do not teach this as rogue-AP prevention.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: An on-screen keyboard may bypass a logger that observes only physical key events.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Screen capture, pointer capture and browser hooks can still collect the input; do not present it as endpoint security.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Anti-malware detection can find and quarantine supported software keyloggers.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Hardware loggers and privileged or novel software require different inspection and recovery steps.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Enforced quotas before expensive work reduce request-exhaustion paths within the service's control.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Distributed sources and constrained upstream links can defeat local request-based protection.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Additional independently provisioned service instances can tolerate some workload pressure or instance failures.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Shared dependencies and total capacity remain finite; balancing is not a complete DoS prevention mechanism.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Lockouts or progressive restrictions slow online guesses on the protected authentication path.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Rigid lockouts can be abused for denial of service and do not stop offline cracking or all distributed spraying.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Automation challenges can add friction to some online guessing tools.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Solvers, relays and bypasses exist; CAPTCHA alone is not a sufficient authentication or guessing defense.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A genuinely one-time code can prevent reuse of a particular authentication value when it is bound and checked correctly.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not provide replay protection for arbitrary application commands or prevent live relay before use.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Authenticated timestamps restrict the age of accepted commands with a defined time window.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Repeated messages inside the window remain possible without additional replay tracking; clock rollback must be handled.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Interpret Tokens specifically as server-validated request-bound anti-CSRF values in this mapping.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Generic session or bearer tokens are not automatically anti-CSRF protection; XSS or leaked tokens can defeat it.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Appropriate SameSite policy reduces cookie sending in selected cross-site contexts.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It is not sufficient for every CSRF situation; unsafe endpoints and same-site attacks remain concerns.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Use cryptographic tag authentication with protected keys and fresh challenges, rather than static identifier acceptance.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Encrypted stored data alone does not prevent cloning or relay; reader and protocol design must be assessed.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Appropriate shielding limits opportunities for unauthorized radio reading while the credential is enclosed.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not protect a credential during legitimate use or invalidate a copy already obtained.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Prefer long unique passwords and common-value blocklists over the legacy idea of predictable complexity recipes.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Composition rules alone can produce guessable patterns; phishing and credential theft are different attack paths.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Unique salts prevent shared offline precomputation against stored verifiers.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Salts do not block online dictionary guesses or eliminate offline guessing of an individual weak password.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Cost-tuned password derivation increases the cost of computing candidates or tables.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Cost alone does not diversify records; unique salts are needed to prevent shared precomputation.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Require removal of shared factory defaults during secure provisioning or after confirmed exposure.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Do not reinterpret this as arbitrary periodic password changes without evidence; predictable replacement patterns can remain weak.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Hardening removes unused default accounts and restricts reachable management interfaces.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A baseline must actually check credentials and effective access; generic hardening does not prove every default is gone.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: An appropriately chosen SHA-3 variant supplies modern collision resistance for suitable designs.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Output size and intended use matter; it is not a generic password-storage or message-authentication replacement.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Independent verification of a support or reward offer checks authority before the requested disclosure or installation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A vague instruction to verify is insufficient without a trusted evidence route and authorization check.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Practice recognizing exchanges of benefits for secrets can improve refusal and reporting decisions.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Training does not prove the actual requester is legitimate or prevent malware execution by itself.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Physical-access monitoring can reveal unexpected accompaniment or movement after entry.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not necessarily stop an unauthorized visitor at the door; observation needs a safe response process.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Electronic access monitoring can detect an unexpected opening or add independent entry verification.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: An electronic label does not imply mechanical pick resistance and an alert may occur after entry.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: An exercised response plan gives staff a safe route to triage questionable incident claims.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A plan alone does not establish that the claim is true or block harmful instructions.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A specified mail or web gateway can reduce ransomware delivery through its inspected channel.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: The broad gateway label is not a universal barrier; direct access, stolen credentials and unknown payloads can bypass it.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Applicable patching removes known exploitation paths used by some ransomware intrusions.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Credential abuse and social engineering can remain, and patching does not reverse existing compromise.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Supplier and build-practice assessments identify risks and enforceable requirements before reliance on a dependency.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A favorable assessment cannot guarantee future publisher or build integrity.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Trusted signature verification detects tampering after signing and binds a release to an accepted publisher key.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A compromised build or signing key can produce a validly signed malicious release; signatures do not prove benign code.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Heuristic or behavior-based detection can identify exploit-like actions before a precise signature exists.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: False positives and unseen techniques remain; do not claim that heuristics detect every zero-day.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Assessed intelligence guides hunting and protective priorities as new exploit evidence emerges.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Intelligence can be incomplete or stale and does not itself block an unknown vulnerability.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Strong verified network isolation removes direct remote paths where the operational design permits it.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Media, maintenance laptops and supply-chain routes can cross the boundary; a claimed air gap is not immunity.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Industrial boundary policy restricts approved control-system paths and supported protocol operations.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Unsafe filtering can cause physical-process disruption; safety engineering and operational validation are necessary.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Independent release and publisher verification supports a trustworthy update decision.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A generic verification instruction needs concrete evidence and cannot certify that an authentic publisher was not compromised.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Signature verification with an independently trusted key detects package tampering after signing.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A correctly signed update can still be malicious if the publisher or signing pipeline was compromised.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Service-access rules reduce reachable propagation paths used by a worm.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Allowed vulnerable services and internal paths may still permit spread; firewall policy does not patch hosts.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: IPS signatures or protocol checks can block recognized worm exploit traffic.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Novel exploits, encryption and evasion reduce coverage; false positives can disrupt legitimate service.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Enforcing appropriate SELinux policy restricts resources a container process can access beyond ordinary permissions.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Permissive mode, broad policy and kernel vulnerabilities can undermine confinement.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Namespaces reduce shared resource views as one component of container isolation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: They are not a complete security boundary; host sockets, privileges and kernel defects can permit breakout.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Check changed payment or disclosure instructions through established business evidence and contacts.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A generic instruction to verify must be turned into a defined independent process.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Enforced DMARC reduces certain unauthorized uses of a protected mail domain.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not stop fraud through a compromised legitimate mailbox or a look-alike domain and does not validate invoice intent.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Role-specific practice helps executives and assistants recognize authority and confidentiality pretexts.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Senior staff still need enforceable verification procedures and technical controls; training alone is insufficient.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Limiting sensitive-data access reduces what a compromised executive workflow can expose.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not authenticate the incoming request and cannot prevent misuse of legitimately permitted data.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: MFA can reduce an attacker's ability to obtain remote access with a stolen password alone.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not stop a Trojan already running or an attacker using an existing victim session or outbound tunnel.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Restrict unnecessary remote-control service exposure and assess outbound connection policy.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A Trojan may use permitted protocols and destinations, so closing inbound ports is not sufficient.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Unusual process or connection behavior can indicate covert remote control for investigation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Legitimate remote administration may look unusual, and attackers can blend into permitted activity.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Correlated endpoint and network observations can identify devices contacting botnet infrastructure.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Indicators can be stale and monitoring alone does not remove the bot or block every control route.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Authorized sinkholing can redirect supported command channels and identify infected clients.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Alternative channels and embedded addresses may survive; authority and collateral effects must be assessed.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Permission and configuration reviews can identify escalation paths and verify remediation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A periodic audit is not continuous enforcement or a patch for an unknown kernel vulnerability.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A correctly planned Kerberos migration can reduce reliance on NTLM when fallback is actually restricted.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Kerberos alone is not a complete pass-the-hash defense and does not prevent stolen-key or stolen-ticket attacks.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Use supported workload admission controls such as Pod Security Admission and assessed admission policies.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: The removed PodSecurityPolicy API is not a current deployment recommendation; runtime and kernel risks remain.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Enforced network zones limit access to and movement from compromised IoT fleets.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Segmentation does not remove bots and cannot automatically absorb traffic aimed at an external victim.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Applicable verified updates remove known device vulnerabilities used for bot recruitment.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Default credentials, unsupported devices and persistence after compromise may still need separate treatment.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Independent verification of identity and intent can interrupt a tailored request before sensitive action.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Familiar context and a genuine compromised mailbox can still mislead; domain authentication is not enough.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Specify the actual mail or endpoint capability used to inspect the spear-phishing delivery path.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Threat Protection is too broad to imply a standardized or universally effective defense without a stated mechanism.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Authorized simulations rehearse response to tailored lures and expose workflow weaknesses.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: An exercise does not verify a real sender or block an actual payload.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Blocking a known compromised destination reduces visits while remediation and investigation proceed.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Previously unclassified or selectively served content can evade filters, and legitimate workflow disruption must be managed.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Endpoint telemetry can reveal exploitation following a visit to a trusted but compromised site.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Detection may occur after execution and depends on sensor visibility and timely response.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Relevant web or endpoint scanning can identify recognized malicious content or exposed vulnerabilities.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A clean scan is point-in-time evidence, not proof that selectively served or novel content is safe.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Education helps users avoid deceptive installers and report suspicious software offers.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A convincing or trusted-source Trojan can still bypass human judgment.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Behavioral detections can reveal a Trojan's actions even when its file appears plausible.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: False positives and evasion remain, and detection needs containment and recovery follow-through.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Applicable updates remove known vulnerabilities that some infected content exploits.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Viruses can also run through user authorization; updates do not guarantee removal of an existing infection.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Antivirus can recognize and quarantine supported infected files and execution behavior.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Novel or concealed infection can be missed and prior compromise may require more than quarantine.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Safer navigation and download handling reduce some exposure to infected programs.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Legitimate sites and publishers can be compromised; user caution is not a complete malware boundary.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Traffic measurements help distinguish attack patterns and select an appropriate mitigation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Analysis does not itself block traffic or restore exhausted network capacity.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Well-managed pins can narrow accepted service identities in controlled clients.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Rollover errors can cause outages, and pinning does not make a compromised endpoint trustworthy.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A verified VPN protects traffic across the segment between its authenticated endpoints.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not authenticate every destination after tunnel termination or make a deceptive Wi-Fi enrollment page safe.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: ASLR makes exploit addresses less predictable where sufficient randomization is available.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Information leaks, low entropy and code reuse can reduce benefit; the overflow still exists.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Compiler canaries detect some protected stack overwrites before control returns.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Not all writes or objects are covered, and leaked guard values can be bypassed.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Review and remove unapproved or excessive-permission extensions as a specific browser-hardening measure.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Adding an arbitrary extension is not protection against a compromised browser, and extensions may be the attack source.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: DNS query, response and administration observations can reveal selected anomalous behavior or unauthorized changes.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: The broad DNS attack category needs a concrete threat; monitoring is not prevention of all DNS failures.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Specify DNSSEC validation, encrypted transport, registrar security or resilience according to the actual threat scenario.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Secure DNS is not one universal control; encryption and data authentication solve different problems.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Strong MFA can reduce takeover from a phished password alone.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Some factors can be phished, and phishing can pursue payments or malware rather than authentication.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Mail inspection can quarantine supported malicious links, attachments and sender patterns before delivery.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: New lures and compromised legitimate senders can pass; false positives require managed handling.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Relevant training improves recognition, verification and reporting of phishing requests.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It is a complementary human layer, not proof that every attack will be recognized.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Supported mobile protections can flag some malicious destinations, apps or unsafe device conditions.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: They cannot establish the truth of every text request and platform sandboxing limits visibility.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Text filtering reduces delivery of recognized spam or malicious-message patterns.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Spoofed senders and novel wording can bypass filtering; a delivered message is not verified as safe.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Validating the expected enterprise authentication-server identity against appropriate CA trust resists a false network server.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A certificate from any trusted issuer is not sufficient without the expected identity; user overrides can defeat validation.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Wireless observations and inventory checks can identify infrastructure imitating a trusted network.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Detection can occur after association and does not itself guarantee credential protection.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A trusted VPN can protect subsequent traffic over an untrusted network segment.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not prevent unsafe automatic association, authenticate the AP or protect credentials typed into a fake pre-tunnel page.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A restrictive correctly deployed CSP can reduce selected script-execution paths as defense in depth.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Permissive policy or trusted-script abuse can bypass protection; unsafe output handling still needs repair.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Resolve paths using platform-aware rules and verify confinement through safe APIs and appropriate authorization.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Naive prefix tests, symbolic links and check/use races can defeat incomplete normalization-based designs.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A correctly configured reduced-privilege chroot confines ordinary path resolution to a chosen tree.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It is not a complete sandbox; privileged operations and unsafe descriptors can undermine it.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Wireless intrusion sensors can alert on suspicious disconnect patterns for investigation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: An IDS does not automatically block frames, and interference or legitimate events can resemble an attack.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Correctly enforced VLAN boundaries reduce some local access to unrelated traffic.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: VLANs do not encrypt packets or replace authorization, and permitted routing or misconfiguration can expose traffic.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Role-scoped permissions limit what an impersonated or compromised identity can access.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: RBAC does not prove the identity is genuine; broad or stale role membership can still enable misuse.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Training helps staff challenge claimed authority and use approved verification routes.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Awareness alone does not authenticate a person or enforce resource permissions.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Controlled scanning can detect supported malicious files before an approved media transfer.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Unknown malware and USB devices emulating keyboards may not be detected by file scanning.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: A workable media policy defines approved devices, inspection and reporting routes.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Written instructions alone do not stop a connected device; technical enforcement and usable alternatives matter.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Individual badge checks support controlled entry and revocation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: A reader at one door does not necessarily stop someone following a badge holder through it.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Trained personnel can observe entry and safely challenge unverified accompaniment.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Coverage, fatigue, social pressure and emergency conditions can limit effectiveness.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Education encourages trusted navigation and careful checking of domain names.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Users cannot reliably detect every visual similarity or encoded hostname variation.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Browser look-alike warnings add a prompt to verify an unusual destination.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Heuristics can miss new patterns or be ignored; they are not authoritative domain-ownership verification.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: HMAC supplies shared-key message authentication for a protocol designed to use it.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It is not a generic replacement for a collision-sensitive public signature or unkeyed integrity design; do not claim universal collision prevention.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Intrusion alarms can notify responders when a physical barrier is forced or opened unexpectedly.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Detection may occur after entry and needs timely response; it does not strengthen the barrier itself.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Authenticated wireless encryption protects content against unauthorized reading even when network surveying is possible.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: It does not prevent detecting or mapping radio networks; authorized wardriving is not inherently malicious.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Suppressing some SSID advertisements only changes simple discovery presentation.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Management exchanges still reveal network identity; hiding SSID is not meaningful protection from surveying or unauthorized access.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Instruction can teach source assessment, uncertainty and responsible sharing.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Training does not directly correct a false claim or establish the facts of a particular event.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: Moderation can reduce circulation of material violating an organization's stated platform policy.
mapping_exceptions.limitations: Moderation is not a universal truth test and can remove legitimate speech if applied poorly.

mapping_exceptions.applicability: AES in an appropriate reviewed construction is designed to tolerate known plaintext rather than relying on secret message formats.
